anomalies.message: CPU load average is significantly high across all intervals (1, 5, 15 minutes), indicating potential overutilization or bottlenecks.
AI module shows no recent learning cycles, confidence, opportunities generated, or adjustments made, indicating potential inactivity or malfunction.
